description: Surgical edits to the pristine Theater 1.10.0 search.chunk.js. Fork mod ported from the 1.9.2 baseline during the 2026-10 re-baseline (previously baked into upstream/theater-1.9.2/search.chunk.js).

ops.note: Search input mirror: poll the (possibly virtual) keyboard's value changes into the app's query setter P() — the VIDAA keyboard sets input.value without firing the events the app listens to. Every typing path goes through one shared debounce (window.__vidaaSearchQ, 1500ms idle; immediate on submit) because each query P() commits is saved to the search history: without it the history filled up letter by letter. Cleared on unmount via the same lifecycle the app uses (a.Ki).
Search field: typing (onChange, also fired per keystroke by the shared TextField's input listener and poll) goes through the debounce; OK/Enter (onSubmit) searches at once.

Keyboard stays open: result rows must not grab focus (spatial-nav focus() blurs the input, which closes the VIDAA keyboard) while the search input is being typed into. Arrow-down still reaches the rows.
